'''Kazuyuki Okitsu''' (Japanese: '''興津和幸''' ''Okitsu Kazuyuki'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Okitsu was born on March 8, 1980, in {{wp|Awaji Island}}, {{wp|Hyōgo Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}. Okitsu first worked on the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|SM}}. His only role so far is [[Ulu]], {{an|Mallow}}'s brother.
